question: Is smell-generality pervasive and permanent?
premises: which commonality indeed is smell-ness, named smell-tanmatra
but because of having a cause, not permanent
inference: Smell-generality pervades but, caused, is impermanent.
plain_english: Which commonality indeed is smell-ness, named smell-tanmatra — that pervasive, therefore so said; but because of having a cause, not permanent.
